# Swecha Enterprises

> Exclusive distributor of physiotherapy and rehabilitation equipment for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, India — the regional distributor of the Monarc Distribution Network portfolio. Headquartered in Hyderabad, founded in 2023. Supplies hospitals, rehabilitation centres and physiotherapy clinics. One point of contact, start to finish.

## Contact
- Phone: +91 98858 39555 (Mon–Sat, 9am–7pm)
- Email: contact@swechaenterprises.com
- Registered office: 11-3-664/238/A/29, Sajeevapuram, Parsigutta, Hyderabad, Telangana 500061, India
- Quotes: https://swechaenterprises.com/contact

## Where we supply
- [Andhra Pradesh](https://swechaenterprises.com/andhra-pradesh): Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore, Tirupati, Kakinada, Rajahmundry, Kurnool, Anantapur, Kadapa, Eluru, Ongole. Customers include Sneha Sandhya Age Care Foundation.
- [Telangana](https://swechaenterprises.com/telangana): Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Warangal, Hanumakonda, Karimnagar, Nizamabad, Khammam, Nalgonda, Mahabubnagar, Siddipet, Adilabad, Suryapet. Customers include AIG Hospitals, Continental Hospitals and the Mallikamba Institute in Hanumakonda.

## Equipment categories
- [Therapeutic Modalities](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/therapeutic-modalities): Combination therapy devices (ultrasound & electrotherapy), Shockwave therapy, High-power laser devices, Low power laser devices, Tecar therapy, Magnetic therapy, Diathermy, TENS Units, Lymphedema Pump.
- [Exercise Therapy](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/exercise-therapy): Parallel bars, Staircase climbers, Quadriceps benches, Active/passive cycles, Resistance Training Equipment, Functional Movement Systems, Therapeutic Exercise Bikes, Pulleys & Weights.
- [Treatment Tables](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/treatment-tables): Electric Hi-Lo Tables, 3D cervical & lumbar decompression tables, Bobath Table, Tilt Tables, Manual Therapy Tables, Traction Tables, Examination Couches.
- [Hydrotherapy](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/hydrotherapy): Whirlpool Tubs, Aquatic Therapy Pools, Underwater Treadmills, Hydrotherapy Jets, Contrast Baths.
- [Interactive Fitness Equipment](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/interactive-fitness): Gamified Exercise Platforms, Virtual Reality Rehab Systems, Smart Treadmills, Digital Training Bikes.
- [Kinesiotherapy](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/kinesiotherapy): Patient lifters & hoists, Sit-to-stand & transfer aids, Walkers, Suspension Therapy Systems, CPM Machines, Hand rehabilitation devices, Balance assessment & training, Gait Trainers, Therapy Ladders.
- [Contrast Therapy (Hot & Cold)](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/contrast-therapy): Cryo-compression, Contrast Bath Units, Hot Pack Units, Paraffin Wax Baths, Cold Therapy Systems, Cryotherapy Devices.
- [Advanced Robotic Systems](https://swechaenterprises.com/products/robotic-rehabilitation): Robot-Assisted Gait Trainers, Robotic Exoskeletons, Upper Limb Robotic Devices, Sensor-Based Feedback Systems.
